UserObject.plantUmlData:
{
  "data": "@startuml DCU_Recepcionista
left to right direction
skinparam actorStyle awesome
skinparam usecase {
  BackgroundColor #F7FAFF
  BorderColor #1F3A6E
}

actor "Recepcionista" as REC
actor "Dueño de la mascota" as DUE

rectangle "Sistema Clínica Veterinaria Patitas" {
  usecase "Registrar dueño" as UC01
  usecase "Registrar mascota" as UC02
  usecase "Transferir mascota\na otro dueño" as UC03
  usecase "Asignar turno" as UC04
  usecase "Reprogramar turno" as UC05
  usecase "Cancelar turno" as UC06
  usecase "Registrar ausencia" as UC07
  usecase "Atender urgencia" as UC08
  usecase "Facturar atención" as UC24

  usecase "Validar disponibilidad\ndel veterinario" as UC09
  usecase "Cobrar cargo por\ncancelación tardía" as UC10
  usecase "Exigir seña" as UC11
  usecase "Notificar al dueño" as UC12
  usecase "Confirmar consulta" as UC17
  usecase "Aplicar descuentos\ny recargos" as UC25
}

REC --> UC01
REC --> UC02
REC --> UC03
REC --> UC04
REC --> UC05
REC --> UC06
REC --> UC07
REC --> UC08
REC --> UC24

DUE <-- UC04 : solicita
DUE <-- UC06 : solicita
DUE <-- UC12 : recibe
DUE <-- UC24 : paga

UC04 ..> UC09 : <<include>>
UC05 ..> UC09 : <<include>>
UC05 ..> UC12 : <<include>>
UC06 <.. UC10 : <<extend>>\n(cancela con menos de 2 h)
UC07 <.. UC11 : <<extend>>\n(3 ausencias seguidas)
UC08 ..> UC04 : <<include>>
UC08 ..> UC05 : <<extend>>\n(si el turno siguiente\nestá ocupado)
UC24 ..> UC17 : <<include>>
UC24 ..> UC25 : <<include>>

note right of UC24
  Solo se factura una consulta
  ya confirmada (S-18).
end note
@enduml",
  "config": null
}

UserObject.label: Solo se factura una consulta ya confirmada (S-18).
UserObject.plantUmlBaseValue: Solo se factura una consulta ya confirmada (S-18).
